event_battles.formation: 0x1A1 both slots: Mega Armor + ProtoArmor (vanilla, read-only reuse; group 40 is also used by vanilla event CB:2599)
event_battles.post_battle: call CA:5EA9 (vanilla: Game Over unless battle switch $40), fade_in, set CELES_ANNEX_TECH_BATTLE_DONE, step party off trigger
event_battles.run_away: Escape is possible (normal monsters). FF6 event scripts cannot distinguish victory from escape (both set battle switch $40), so escape also completes the TECH battle step.
event_battles.defeat: Vanilla Game Over -> reload last save.
